title: Length 84 with m≥3 is excluded at residual floor 261
statement: A cheap refinement of the odd-run height law or the Lean inv-sum cap excludes every Juggler CycleMin of length 84 with at least three odd-runs at the live residual floor 261, so the leftover becomes period ≥85.
counterexamples: L=84, o=53, m=3, n=261, θ≈0.002086: height constant 1 RHS≈0.002193; constant 6/5 RHS≈0.002631; joint constant 1 RHS≈0.003527
Lean inv-sum full-height cap S≈0.012672 > θ·61/11≈0.011568
T(261)=4216 is even, so the CycleMin start odd-run has length 1; packing that singleton plus other valleys at n+2 still has RHS≈0.002179>θ
Pigeonhole k≥18 does not starve evens: ~11 square-roots return to scale n, and 29 evens can sit on that circuit
notes: Height first kills m=3 at 273 and every m at 1981. Those residual-floor campaigns stay PARK. Equal-valleys n+2 is a separate REFUTED leftover-killer. Not a halt theorem.
tested_range: L=84, o=53, m=3..31, n=261; height/joint/Lean inv-sum/singleton-start+n+2; T-parity on odd n in 257..299
